resolution_policy.MISSING_SYMBOL_BINDING: Match every baseline symbol uniquely to a current non-empty parser-derived signature using path, terminal qualified name, source blob SHA, and source-start-line delta <= 1.
resolution_policy.UNRESOLVED_FILE_STATUS: Require the same path and blob SHA in the current pinned inventory, with an authoritative parser result or a matching evidence-backed exclusion.
resolution_policy.PARSER_NOT_AUTHORITATIVE: Require exact allowlisted parser mode, AUTHORITATIVE_COMPLETE status, zero unsupported files, and zero parse errors.
resolution_policy.CATALOG_FILE_NOT_IN_SOURCE_CENSUS: Resolve only through an exact added-file record in the expected-delta contract with matching old/new blob bindings and passing independent tree gates.
resolution_policy.FILE_BLOB_MISMATCH: Resolve only through an exact modified-file record in the expected-delta contract with matching old/new blob bindings and passing independent tree gates.

governance: This contract pins the historical baseline for per-finding accounting. It does not approve merge or imply organization-wide VERIFIED status.
